labels.reason: The body reports apparent Vd, Ka, Ke, PPB, BPR and strain-specific MIC, with rat characteristics, dosing and sampling context. It contains no concentration-time observations: measured concentrations are explicitly located in inaccessible Supplementary Table S1. Requirement links represent partial, source-backed input coverage only. PK experimental-unit identifiers, individual variability, dose basis, complete conversion justification and several binding definitions remain unresolved. Apparent Vd is not identified as Vss, and no CL estimate is reported. The infection context supports partial DRQ30 coverage without establishing a PK-to-PD exposure-response relationship. No fitting, parameter qualification or translation acceptance is established.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T5:A48 explicitly places measured concentrations in Supplementary Table S1 (not accessible). Sampling times and reported parameters are available, but concentration-time modeling inputs remain UNRESOLVED. This item cannot establish observed time-course coverage or held-out membership.
findings.needed_material: Readable, authorized concentration-time records with units, sampling time origin, study/regimen membership, experimental-unit identifiers and censoring metadata; otherwise document the restricted reported-parameter use.

findings.reason: Origin: main:/missing_information/items/13. Field: Support for individual PK variability. Status: DEFERRED; resolution_status: OPEN; needed_at: pk. Impact: A defensible individual-variability basis for subsequent population predictions has not been established. Original why_it_matters: The proposal describes summary-level evidence and prohibits invented variability, but does not establish whether defensible individual PK variability can be supported. Attachment bodies remain NOT_SEARCHED. This reviewed item reports PK in 6 septic rats and PPB n = 3, but neither establishes verified individual PK records, sampling structure or PK variability. DRQ09 is not matched.
findings.needed_material: Assess the available experimental units and variability evidence during PK work; record supported variability or the resulting limitation without manufacturing it from group summaries.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs include the single 100 mg/kg s.c. dose, administration 2 h after infection and printed sampling times. Dose composition/basis and explicit sampling time origin are NOT_FOUND, so the complete input-history assessment remains UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed dose basis and explicit sampling time origin. Preserve the single-dose regimen without importing schedules from another study.

findings.reason: The source states that WHOLE BLOOD measurements were converted to free plasma concentration with PPB and BPR. PPB and BPR values are supplied, but the conversion equation, justification, whole-blood total/unbound definition and parameter concentration basis are NOT_FOUND. Vd is explicitly per animal.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed conversion definition and justification, applicability of PPB/BPR to the measured samples, and concentration basis used for the reported parameters. Retain measured whole blood and converted free plasma separately.

findings.reason: PPB 15% is an AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE bound-percentage input with ultrafiltration, 30K MWCO, n = 3 and 10 μg/mL stated. It is not a directly measured free concentration or a supplied fu. Temperature, pH, recovery, nonspecific binding, mass balance, replicate summary definition and BPR measurement conditions are NOT_FOUND. Applicability remains UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: Binding and BPR measurement definitions and conditions, available recovery information, and the source-supported applicability assessment for the intended unbound endpoint.

findings.reason: The table reports Apparent volume of distribution (Vd), 0.326 L, with a per-animal qualification. It does not identify Vss or supply its estimation method or uncertainty. Ka and Ke do not establish Vss input sufficiency. DRQ16 is not matched, and no CL estimate supports DRQ15.
findings.needed_material: If Vss or CL is selected downstream, obtain the exact parameter definition, estimation method and corresponding input evidence; otherwise retain Vd, Ka and Ke solely as unvalidated reported parameters.

findings.reason: The species, neutropenic septic state, body-weight range and per-animal Vd unit are source-backed candidates. Actual contributing-animal weights, parameter uncertainty and a defined mapping to a requested translation parameter are NOT_FOUND. The range 180-220 g must not be substituted for actual study weights or converted into a single weight.
findings.needed_material: Actual study weights where required by the considered scaling approach, exact requested parameter definitions and source/review status for each candidate.

findings.reason: Organism/strain, inoculum, infection route, host state and administration 2 h after infection are available. This item contains no measured PD response, untreated growth controls, treatment-duration comparison, dosing-interval variation or source-supported PK-to-PD mapping. Response-linked applicability remains UNRESOLVED.
findings.needed_material: If used for index ranking or target estimation, obtain matched response records, endpoint/reference window, controls, regimen variation and an explicit assessment of PK transfer to those regimens.

findings.reason: MIC of P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 is reported as 0.125 mg/L. Susceptibility method, medium, testing standard, replicate count and summary definition are NOT_FOUND on this page.
findings.needed_material: Independent review should route this MIC evidence to the appropriate susceptibility-input assessment without inventing an unassigned requirement ID.

findings.reason: Value as printed combines PK parameters, binding, BPR and MIC. No common column unit is stated; row-specific L, h−1, %, μg/mL and mg/L remain in the cited body evidence. BPR has no printed unit. The Vd per-animal qualification and PPB-specific qualifiers apply only to their respective rows.
findings.needed_material: Preserve row-specific quantity, unit and qualifier associations during preparation; do not apply a single unit or PPB qualifier to the entire value column.
